text.en: Believing any quantum state with uncertainty about a measurement outcome must be a mixed state — a pure state, like a superposition of energy eigenstates, has genuine quantum uncertainty about energy while still being a single, completely known state; that's different from not knowing which pure state the system is actually in.
text.et: Arvamus, et iga kvantolek määramatusega mõõtmistulemuse suhtes peab olema segaolek — puhas olek, nagu energia omaolekute superpositsioon, omab tõelist kvantmääramatust energia suhtes, olles ikkagi üksik, täielikult teada olek; see erineb sellest, et ei teata, millises puhtas olekus süsteem tegelikult on.
